content: PostgreSQL docs (functions-conditional.html): GREATEST/LEAST IGNORE NULL arguments - NULL values in the argument list are ignored; result is NULL only if ALL expressions are NULL; explicit deviation from SQL standard. So GREATEST(last_checked NULL, lastTs) returns lastTs - the D-5 monotonic-max flush needs NO COALESCE. Asymmetry: SQL comparisons with NULL (CASE WHEN lastTs > last_checked) yield NULL=not-true, taking ELSE branch - response_time CASE guard behaves differently on NULL than GREATEST. Spec must pin this non-standard Postgres behavior explicitly.
